reason.en: The entire contents of one 5 g applicator once intravaginally at any time of day.

text.en: Hypersensitivity to clindamycin or lincosamides; history of regional enteritis, ulcerative colitis or C. difficile diarrhoea.

text.fa: برچسب خطر مشخصی برای بارداری ذکر نکرده یا داده کافی ندارد؛ فقط در صورت لزوم و با نظر پزشک.
text.en: Label states no clear risk or has limited data; use only if needed, under medical advice.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary Clindesse has not been studied in pregnant women.

text.fa: برچسب: در شیردهی با احتیاط؛ متن برچسب را ببینید.
text.en: Label: use with caution while breastfeeding; see the label text.

lactation.quote: Risk Summary The systemic exposure (based on AUC and C max ) of Clindesse is substantially lower than intravenous administration of clindamycin [see Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.3 )] ; therefore, adverse effects on the breastfed infant are not expected from transfer of clindamycin into breastmilk.

text.fa: برچسب برای کودکان شرط، محدودیت سنی یا نکته دارد؛ جمله برچسب در زیر آمده است.
text.en: The label has conditions, age limits or notes for children; the label sentence is quoted below.

pediatric.quote: The safety and efficacy of Clindesse in the treatment of bacterial vaginosis in post-menarchal females have been established on the extrapolation of clinical trial data from adult women.

text.fa: برچسب: در سالمندان با احتیاط و معمولاً از دوز پایین شروع شود.
text.en: Label: use with caution in older adults, usually starting at the low end of the dose range.

geriatric.quote: Clinical studies with Clindesse did not include sufficient numbers of subjects 65 years of age or older to determine whether they respond differently than younger subjects.

text.fa: برچسب نکته‌ای درباره بارداری، پیشگیری یا باروری زنان و مردان دارد.
text.en: Label has advice on pregnancy testing, contraception or fertility for females and males.

reproductive.quote: Contraception Clindesse contains mineral oil that may weaken latex or rubber products such as condoms or vaginal contraceptive diaphragms.
